emails.subject: Action requested: DK on CIM-261118-9595
emails.body:
Dear Client,

The delivery under DTC reference DTC-DO-20261119-000044 was DK'd for a reported quantity mismatch. Both the DTC activity and your recorded instruction show 20,000 shares and USD 7,802,400; the cause is not yet verified.

Please check your latest allocation and intended settlement details, including the counterparty, and re-instruct or confirm the correct details. Please also advise of any relevant repair or inquiry.

Regards,
BNY Operations

emails.to: Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC — Fails Desk (participant 7101; role to be confirmed)
emails.subject: DK notification: DTC-DO-20261119-000044
emails.body:
Dear Fails Desk,

DTC reference DTC-DO-20261119-000044 was DK'd for a reported quantity mismatch. The recorded DTC delivery and our instruction both show 20,000 shares and USD 7,802,400. We have asked our client to check and confirm or re-instruct; the correct details and cause are not yet verified.

Please check the delivery and confirm your role and instruction details. Our records show participant 7101 as the DTC receiver but as the counterparty on our instruction.

Regards,
BNY Operations
